context.cutoff: Evidence appended and received strictly before frozen base context decision_time; publication, when known, strictly earlier too. No later reports/digests. Receipts snapshotted under radar shared owner lock and SQLite read transaction; regime/anomalies/priced-in recomputed after releasing that lock.
context.veille: Explicit timestamp/date in a line or inherited dated section/note; date-only means end of UTC day; timestamp must precede cutoff. File mtime must precede cutoff. Snapshot frozen before base inference.
context.data: Headlines, source URLs, levels, scores and measured numbers only; no article bodies or runtime paths.

budgets.bank: Separate durable news_ kinds, per actual UTC dispatch day, including failed attempts; never borrow base budgets.

promotion.comparison: Same prospective A/B sessions/universe, per analyst/reviewed role, population and horizon; historical pre-A/B base excluded. News hit_rate strictly greater AND Brier strictly lower. No pooling roles, horizons or populations.
promotion.execution: Operator approval and a new execution registration required even when eligible. Crypto has no SPY-relative target: descriptive raw scores only, never automatic eligibility.

downgrade_breaker.unit: Completely closed entry lot with terminal entry observation and nonzero allocated fill, cumulative exits deduped by client/lot. Partial/unfilled/pending lots excluded. All horizons/populations of this tier pooled for the safety decision only.
downgrade_breaker.cost_basis: Actual filled entry/exit prices include slippage; deduct additional preregistered conservative 15bp of absolute filled entry notional (5bp per side + 2.5bp half spread per side). Broker fees not separately observed.
downgrade_breaker.evaluation: Every prefix of completed lots in realization order; crossing latches permanently. Register additive safety contract explicitly before use; original execution v3 bindings are not migrated. Refuse new entries and crashed unsubmitted intents containing the tier; mark unknown-at-broker intents NOT_TRADED. Cancel known accepted open entry orders containing the tier (whole order if mixed). Enforce again at submission. Scheduled exits and research scoring continue. Resume requires a new operator decision.
